context: M3.1 second-campaign model selection (retry after opus-4-8 budget cap)

option_a_opus_subagent.uses_credentials: Claude Code subscription/API (NOT the LiteLLM key) -> avoids the LiteLLM claude-opus-4-8 budget cap
option_a_opus_subagent.why_not: Claude Code 2.1.263 exposes no mechanism to (a) restrict an Agent-tool subagent to only the RED_LOOP typed broker + corpus-retrieval tools, (b) deny it shell/filesystem access to answer-key material (reports, RED_LOOP internals, calibration, known_gaps, judge), or (c) route its turns through the RED_LOOP deterministic judge, context compiler, packet-metrics and stagnation logic, which live only in the Python run_campaign loop driven by an HTTP LiteLLM call. Using it as primary would require an ad-hoc unlogged campaign path that bypasses the RED_LOOP evidence format and the Section-5 isolation -- explicitly forbidden. Fall back to Kimi K3.

option_b_kimi_k3.why: strongest usable Kimi alias; different budget pool than the exhausted claude-opus-4-8; verified tool-calling + context-compiler compatibility via the existing LiteLLM adapter

reproducer.provider_diversity: OpenAI GPT, distinct from Kimi (Moonshot) primary

isolation_note: The LiteLLM primary receives ONLY the system mandate, the compiled state from a blank store, tool schemas, and a bounded raw window. It has no access to the parent conversation, prior campaigns, calibration, reports, judge code, or the filesystem; it can only call the typed broker + corpus tools. Corpus is restricted to the 5 accepted source roots.
